decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1).The proposed development, due to its size, scale and appearance would represent an incongruous structure, over developing the site and resulting in an unattractive addition to the area, harmful to the appearance of the street scene and  surrounding area. It would therefore constitute inappropriate infill development and be contrary to policy H.6.3 (Back land Development/Infill Development) and ENV.B.1.1 (All New Development) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
2) The proposed dwelling by reason of its siting, size and scale would have an adverse affect upon the outlook from neighbouring properties, specifically No.308 Twickenham Road and properties along the northern side of Northcote Avenue. This is contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) and H.6.3 (Infill / Backland Development) of the London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development.
description: Erection of a pair of 2 bed semi detached properties to rear fronting Woodstock Avenue incorporating 2 parking spaces.
